_comment: The 'big boys' — the heavyweight operators, grouped by whoever runs them.
These ARE targets: the team attacks them in a coordinated push, so nothing here is
excluded from offense and no row is greyed. The grouping is for attribution — it turns
a list of bare ids into 'that block is Graveyard's' when reading the board.
Was data/do-not-target.json, when the policy was to leave them alone.
Allies — the one list that IS a hard block on offense — live in ally-tokens.json.
